title: Rav Avdimi bar Hamdura
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: [Sukkah 20a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sukkah.20a.10) mentions his explanation of chotzalot as marzovli, which Rabbi Abba explains. Hyman considers it very likely that he is the Bar Hamduri mentioned without a first name, Shmuel’s student who lived into Rava’s time. Hyman objects to Seder HaDorot’s claim that Resh Lakish explains him there: Rabbi Abba explains him, while Resh Lakish disagrees.[^1]

notes.text: [Rashi](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Sukkah.20a.10.1) describes the objects as something a shepherd places under his head. [Heilprin’s Avdimi entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=101&lang=en) says that both sages explained him. Hyman distinguishes Rabbi Abba’s gloss from Resh Lakish’s separate interpretation as mats. [Heilprin’s Ben Hammedori entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=733&lang=en) also questions the proposed lifespan from Shmuel to Rava.
